text:
jamie_sales: Opening thread for Acme POC questions. They require Okta SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning (50k initial import, then daily deltas), RBAC via Okta groups, domain verification for tenant-proofing, and a 2-week Dedicated burst quote for load tests. Need clear ops + security + pricing answers.

noah_se: Quick clarifier: will Acme use Okta Group Push today or migrate groups via SCIM? Also, do they need SAML role attributes as a fallback?

cfo_acme: We can provide an initial CSV export for the 50k users and prefer SCIM for ongoing sync. Okta will include a Roles attribute in SAML but group->role mapping is preferred.

noah_se: Recommended POC plan: 1) presigned S3 CSV ingest for bulk import to avoid 50k SCIM requests; 2) scoped SCIM token for deltas; 3) group->role mapping via JSON config. Example mapping below.

noah_se: Example mapping snippet:
```
{"okta_group": "acme_admins", "redwood_role": "admin"}
{"okta_group": "acme_engineers", "redwood_role": "engineer"}
```

isabel_security: From the security questionnaire: 1) assertion encryption? We support encrypted SAML assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM) if SP metadata includes encryption KeyDescriptor. 2) SCIM transport: hosted = TLS + bearer token; mTLS only on Dedicated/Private. 3) Audit log retention: hosted default 90 days; enterprise add-on or Dedicated can be 12 months.

cfo_acme: Procurement requires mTLS for provisioning and 12mo logs. Is mTLS possible during a hosted trial?

isabel_security: Short answer: no for hosted. mTLS requires Dedicated or Private. If they insist on mTLS we should propose a short Dedicated burst with mTLS enabled. Also we'll attach SOC2 and pen-test artifacts to the thread after approvals.

noah_se: Ops checklist for POC: 1) exchange SP metadata (we provide ACS + EntityID); 2) confirm CSV schema and sample; 3) share group->role mapping JSON; 4) confirm deployment mode (hosted trial vs Dedicated with mTLS); 5) pricing: pro-rated Dedicated burst quote + overage rates.

s3-bot: [s3-bot] Presigned S3 URL created: https://storage.redwood.ai/presign/acme-poc-2500 (24h expiry)

jamie_sales: Action items: - cfo_acme to upload SP metadata and grant S3 access or confirm presigned URL use by EOD; - isabel to post SOC2 link + pentest summary; - noah to draft burst quote (daily rate + per-1k TPS overage). We'll reconvene after docs are in. :thumbsup:
